# Quota disclosure fixtures

Text extracted with the bundled pypdf runtime from manager disclosures mirrored by Eastmoney,
retrieved on 2026-10-15. Preserve table order and PDF extraction whitespace.

- `001668-restore.txt`: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202610131830379150_1.pdf
  Restores RMB A/C/D subscriptions effective 2026-10-13; USD is not restored by this notice.
- `001668-cap.txt`: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202610131830379171_1.pdf
  Sets separate RMB A/C/D daily ceilings of CNY 300 and a USD-share ceiling of USD 50,
  effective 2026-10-13.
- `001668-direct-cap.txt`: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202609081829112720_1.pdf
  Changes direct sale only to CNY 50,000, leaving agency ceilings unchanged.
- `000043-channel-caps.txt`: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202511041774776219_1.pdf
  Mixed inline-currency table with CNY 100 agency / CNY 100,000 direct ceilings.
- `040046-share-table.txt`: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202609231829773864_1.pdf
  Dash cells for shares outside the notice scope.
- `539001-share-table.txt`: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202608191828132673_1.pdf
  Repeated table cells across a page boundary and a separate direct-sale exception.
- `012060-share-table.txt`: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202511201784706403_1.pdf
  A shared yuan table header with a USD-share currency override in its footnote/share header.
- `006555-share-table.txt`: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202609181829580901_1.pdf
  Standalone page footer between amount rows.
- `006373-share-table.txt`: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202602051819781274_1.pdf
  Fullwidth thousands comma.
- `164212-share-table.txt`: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202607241827305255_1.pdf
  Amount cells interleaved into the unit label; a C-share direct-sale override does not change A.
